assign.title: Agent-name links in chat go to a page that does not exist. ext/Mention/Mention.js agent_entry() (line ~106) builds `/fra

log: built AgentUrl (ai/index.json lookup), Mention retarget, session not-found page; smoke no FAIL, docs updated; committing, then fresh review

findings.text: One of the owner's own example links still fails. `/framework/ai/sessions/minion-dataflow-doc/` shows "Session not found" (headless shot at 1200), because the agent's real id is `minion-minion-dataflow-doc` (folder `sessions/2026/10/25/session-d3ed399d/minion-minion-dataflow-doc/`). `AgentUrl.build()` (`ai/AISession/AgentUrl.js:20`) needs a fallback that matches the doubled `minion-minion-` prefix, or the task has to report that Servex mints that doubled name.

`AgentUrl.build()` trusts a stale `task_dir` ahead of the agent's real task url (`AgentUrl.js:30-33`). Run against the live `ai/index.json`, 345 of the 975 mapped urls point at folders that no longer exist (for example `minion-voice-on-panel` → `/framework/ai/2026-09-29/voice-on-panel/`), so those links still 404. For 311 of the 345, the index's `tasks[]` has a url that does exist: prefer that url, and use `task_dir` only as the last resort.

Requirement 2 is only half met. The not-found page covers bare names, but `AISessionDetail.known()` (`AISessionDetail.js:83`) accepts any 8-hex prefix or `v-…` id without checking for a record. A uuid with no `session.jsonl` still gets `AISessionDetail`, whose `SessionOutlineView.js:22` shows "Reading this session's record…" with no timeout. The headless shot of `/sessions/deadbeef-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/` never settled (goto timed out after 30 s). Show the not-found message when the record fetch 404s, not only for an unknown name.

A fresh agent cannot continue from this task folder. It has no `requirements.md` (the brief exists only in the spawn transcript and as a truncated `title` in `session.jsonl` line 1), no landing line or outcome, and no record of requirement 3 ("open one real agent page at its dated url and confirm it loads; report if the page is broken"). The only evidence is a log line, "smoke no FAIL". Write the brief to `requirements.md` and land the task with the check's result.

Requirement 3 holds in my own check: `/framework/ai/sessions/mastermind-tasks-completion/` redirects to its dated folder and draws Requirements · Report · Session with content. The Report tab says "complete · 0 of 0 tasks complete / complete" and still shows a "starting" dot, which repeats itself and contradicts itself: worth reporting as "page itself broken beyond the url".

`ai/index.json` is about 3 MB and gitignored (`.gitignore:222`). Every page that draws an agent mention now fetches it once (`Mention.js` `agent_entry` → `AgentUrl.load()`), and on the static production site it is absent, so links fall back to `/sessions/<name>/`. This is fine for dev, but a small name→url map written by `Server/AIIndex.mjs` would be cheaper.
The comment "one session, one url: the dated folder…" moved off the redirect line onto the `missing` line (`AISessionsPage.js:754`), where it no longer describes the code.

`load_row()` now also falls through to `tree_row()` (`AISessionDetail.js:481`), which changes the result for every caller of `load_row`, not only `known()`. That looks intended, but neither readme says so.
